name: unsafe fn set_var < K : AsRef < OsStr > , V : AsRef < OsStr > > (key : K , value : V)
rule: When calling `set_var` in a multi-threaded program on an operating system other than Windows, the caller must ensure that no other threads concurrently write or read the environment through functions or global variables other than those in `std::env`.
